protocol.manual: DM-G15-42 v1.04, printed page 41: ExtTrig Delay lies between incoming trigger edge and exposure start; Strobe Delay controls the separate output pulse.
protocol.setting_evidence: pretest_verified.json; baseline_exposure, baseline_trigger, baseline_format, freeze_on and freeze_off direct OSD crops.
protocol.sampling_selection: Reused final r4 rising-edge taps from prior phase qualification; fresh five-camera frozen-image control at 1/60 s.
protocol.limits: Nominal reference is uncalibrated. Raster boundaries and qualified ROI changes do not establish physical exposure starts or shared frame identity. DNR remains enabled. Capture gaps are not joined.
protocol.trigger_scope: ILA measures the common FPGA-generated trigger; electrical arrival, optocoupler latency and acceptance at camera inputs are not measured.
protocol.timestamp_boundary: V 1-to-0 active-raster boundary. CRC describes the preceding complete raster.
